title: Segregation compliance
text: Compliance is the share of checked deliveries that arrived already segregated (wet and dry kept apart at home). Higher is better. The Segregation page shows it per purok.

title: Segregated, mixed, wet and dry
text: When a delivery is checked, the operator marks it Segregated (already separated at home) or Mixed, and records its wet kg (biodegradable, goes to compost) and dry kg (goes on to sorting).
questions: ano ang ibig sabihin ng mixed
difference between wet and dry waste

title: Residual
text: Residual is waste that can't be recycled or composted. In storage it is stock with no recyclable material set, and it leaves the MRF as "Residual for disposal".
questions: ano ang ibig sabihin ng residual

title: Material vs waste category
text: Waste categories (Recyclable, Biodegradable, Residual, Mixed household) describe a whole drop-off at intake and are used for forecasts. Recyclable materials (Plastic, Paper, Metal...) are what sorted waste is stored and sold as.

title: Purok (source area)
text: A purok is a source area that delivers waste to the MRF. Deliveries, compliance and intake reports are counted per purok. They are listed under Master data > Source areas.

title: Storage area, capacity and alert %
text: A storage area holds sorted materials. Its capacity is how many kg it holds; the alert % is how full it may get before an alert is raised. The bars say "almost full" at the alert % and "over capacity" above 100%.

title: Compost batch
text: A compost batch is wet waste put into a compost bay on one day. It has a code, its age in days and its starting kg. Operators log turning, watering and checks, then finish it with the kg of compost made.

title: Record codes (D-, O-, K-, B-, R-)
text: D- is a delivery (drop-off). O- is an outgoing record (sale, give-away, compost or disposal). K- is a kiosk receipt made while SapulMRF was offline; the kiosk sends it later and it gets a D- code. B- is a compost batch. R- is an operator's problem report.
questions: ano ang k code sa resibo

title: Give-away
text: A give-away is recyclables given out for free. It takes stock out like a sale but never has a price, and income reports leave it out. It shows as "Recyclables given away (free)".

title: Reverse (undo a sale or recount)
text: Sales, give-aways and recounts count at once; the admin checks them afterwards. Reverse puts the stock back today. A reversed sale comes off income on the day it was reversed; the original day keeps its record.
questions: what happens when i reverse a sale

title: Recount
text: A recount is an operator counting the stock in an area again. It changes the stock at once (Was > Counted), and the admin reviews it afterwards: OK, or Reverse to bring the old count back.
questions: what does was and counted mean

title: Fix (undo a record)
text: A fix undoes a step of a delivery (the sort, the wet/dry check, or the whole record) with a reason, so it can be recorded again. Marking a fix OK or Wrong is only a mark: the undo already happened.

title: Corrected weight
text: A corrected weight is a delivery whose scale reading was changed by hand. The review shows what the scale said and what it was corrected to.

title: Unusual delivery (flag) and false alarm
text: A flag marks a delivery whose weight is far from that purok's usual weights, or whose sorted kg doesn't match what came in. Flags never change records. Valid means it really is unusual; False alarm means it's normal.

title: Camera suggestion and kept %
text: The kiosk camera suggests a material for each drop-off. Kept % is the share of suggestions the operator kept as suggested; changed ones can be marked OK or Wrong by the admin.

title: Forecast and its error
text: The forecast predicts kg per day for the next 7 days from the MRF's own records. Two models run side by side (a 7-day average and a Ridge regression); the one that was closer recently is used. The error is how far off it was, as % of the total kg.

title: Kiosk PIN
text: Each operator sets their own kiosk PIN on their Profile and signs in at the kiosk with it. An admin can't see or set it, only clear it (Settings > Users > Edit > Clear kiosk PIN).
questions: how do operators sign in at the kiosk

title: Roles
text: Barangay Administrator manages accounts, settings and approvals. MRF Operator records the daily work. Authorized Barangay Staff can only view, and only the screens turned on for them.

title: Buyer
text: Buyers are the junkshops and recipients the kiosk shows as buttons when selling or giving out. They are managed under Master data > Buyers.
questions: where do buyer buttons come from

title: Device online / offline
text: A device counts as online when it checked in within the last 2 minutes. A new key stops the old one working right away.

title: Export a report
text: Reports can be downloaded as PDF or CSV.
steps: Pick a report card (Intake, Segregation, Inventory, Composting, Outgoing material or Income).
Set "From" and "To" (and "Source area" for Intake or Segregation).
questions: how do i export a report

title: Download an earlier report again
text: Earlier exports are listed under Recent reports. Downloading again rebuilds the file from today's data.

title: Review sales and give-aways
text: Operators' sales and give-outs count at once; you check them afterwards.
questions: how do i approve a sale
saan makikita ang mga benta na ire-review

title: Reverse a sale or give-away
text: Reversing puts the stock back today and takes a sale off income on the day you reverse it.
questions: how do i reverse a sale

title: Review a recount
text: Recounts change stock at once; you check them afterwards.
steps: Click "OK", or "Reverse...", type why and click "Reverse".
questions: how do i review a recount

title: Review a fix
text: Fixes were already undone; your mark records whether the fix was right.

title: Decide a flagged record
text: Flags never change records; you mark whether the weight really is unusual.
questions: how do i clear a flag

title: Review camera corrections
text: When an operator changes the camera's suggestion, you can mark the change OK or Wrong.

title: Undo a delivery step from Intake
text: You can undo the sort, the wet/dry check, or a whole delivery, any day.
steps: Open Operations > Intake and find the record (search by code).
Pick what to undo (e.g. "The sort" or "The whole record").
questions: how do i delete a delivery

title: Record a sale or give-out yourself
text: Admins can record outgoing material too; stock leaves at once.
steps: Open Operations > Outgoing and click "+ Record outgoing".
Pick the "Type", then the "Material" and "From storage".
Pick the "Buyer" or "Recipient" and type the kg (and the price for a sale).
questions: how do i record a sale

title: Acknowledge an alert
text: Acknowledging says you've seen it; the alert stays until its condition clears.

title: Resolve an operator's problem report
text: Problem reports stay open until you say what was done.

paano sagutin ang report ng operator

title: Add a user
text: Each person gets their own account and role.
steps: Open Settings > Users and click "+ Add user".
questions: how do i add a user
create an account for an operator

title: Disable a user or reset a password
text: Edit the person's account; you can't disable yourself or change your own role.
steps: Open Settings > Users and click "Edit" on the person.
Type a "New password", untick "Account active", or click "Clear kiosk PIN".
questions: how do i disable a user

title: Change your own password
text: Admins change their password on their own row in Users.
steps: Open Settings > Users and click "Edit" on your own name.
questions: where can i change my password

title: Give staff access to screens
text: Staff are view-only; you turn screens on per person.
steps: Under "Staff access, per person", tick the screens for each person.

paano bigyan ng access ang staff
turn on a screen for staff

title: Add a buyer
text: Buyers show as buttons on the kiosk when selling.
steps: Click "Add buyer". To retire one: "Edit", untick "Active", "Save changes".

title: Add a purok, category or material
text: Source areas (puroks), waste categories and materials are master data.
steps: Open Settings > Master data and pick the card (Source areas, Waste categories or Recyclable materials).
questions: how do i add a purok

title: Add or change a storage area
text: Each storage area has a capacity and an alert %.
steps: Open Settings > Master data, card "Storage areas".
Click "+ Add" and fill "Name", "Capacity (kg)" and "Alert when this full (%)".
Click "Add storage area" (or "Edit" > "Save changes" to change one).

title: Register the kiosk or another device
text: A device needs a key to send data; the key is shown once.
steps: Open Settings > IoT devices and click "+ Register device".
Click "Copy key" and keep it safe, then "Done". (New key: "Edit" > "Generate new key".)
questions: how do i register the kiosk

title: Change limits (ranges)
text: Ranges set the days of records before predictions show, how strict the unusual-weight check is, and storage capacities.
questions: how do i change the limits
make the unusual weight check stricter

title: Log out
text: Log out from the account menu at the top right.
steps: Click your name at the top right.

title: Activity log
text: Every sign-in, change and export is logged. You can filter it and export it as CSV.
steps: Pick a period, an action type or a person.
Click "Export CSV" to keep a copy.

title: Live camera
text: The kiosk camera's live view, with what it detects, plus today's camera numbers.

title: Predictions (Insights)
text: Forecasts, the storage outlook, a suggested pickup or sale date and the camera's accuracy.

title: Overview
text: Today's MRF at a glance: received today, approvals waiting, compliance, storage, income and alerts.

title: Compost
text: Batches in progress and those finished in the last 30 days, with their logged turning, watering and checks.
